title: ask_user
description: Pause and ask the human a free-text question. Use this only when you're genuinely stuck (the task is ambiguous between reasonable interpretations, or you've tried multiple reasonable fixes and still can't succeed) — not as a shortcut for something you could find out yourself with read_file/list_dir/search_code. This is not a tool call in the usual sense: it never touches the repository, requires no confirmation, and the human's reply comes back as your next observation.

question.description: A specific, answerable question — explain what you've tried or what's ambiguous, not just "what should I do?".
